purpose: Primary document observation and local source/ABI compatibility review; not wire/RPC/provider approval

primary_sources.heading: SeaDrop / v1 contracts
primary_sources.excerpt: OpenSea Studio uses public and server-signed allowlist stages.
primary_sources.assessment: Current product description differs from the reviewed Merkle-only PoPL configuration. Actual custom onboarding remains unknown.

primary_sources.heading: Customize a SeaDrop contract / Write your own
primary_sources.excerpt: Studio publishes stages and payouts through multiConfigure.
primary_sources.assessment: PoPL compiled NFT ABI lacks this selector. Individual on-chain configuration capability does not prove ordinary Studio Publish compatibility.

primary_sources.heading: Deployments / Networks
primary_sources.assessment: Current primary registry lists Robinhood4663 Standard V1. No new runtime probe here; prior dated witness retained.

primary_sources.heading: Optional: Drop from a contract you already deployed
primary_sources.assessment: Adapters require platform linking and are described as unaudited; not a preapproved replacement for custom PoPL minting.

primary_sources.heading: What fees do I pay on OpenSea? / OpenSea Fee
primary_sources.assessment: Typical primary fee10%, changeable. Collection-specific fee/recipient/payer still unapproved; conditional0.05 gross yields0.045 net.

primary_sources.heading: Supported Networks
primary_sources.assessment: No Robinhood entry found in current full catalog. Other-chain coordinator addresses not portable qualification.

primary_sources.heading: Documentation / A consumer contract / Addresses chain id4663
primary_sources.assessment: Published tuple, zero-lane example, native funding and retry are leads; no inference that nonzero lanes are rejected without code review.

primary_sources.heading: Before you integrate / What if a signature never arrives at all?
primary_sources.assessment: Unserved refund after7200L1blocks permanently prevents later fulfillment, incompatible with required valid-original-request recovery.

primary_sources.heading: Security model / Robinhood Chain delivery and refunds / upgrades
primary_sources.assessment: Distinct interface/trust,60second fee-refund and owner-controlled UUPS coordinator require separate original-request/code review.

primary_sources.heading: Connecting to Robinhood Chain / Developer Endpoints / Public Endpoints
primary_sources.assessment: Provider-backed/archive guidance; public endpoints rate-limited/not recommended for production. No account/tier selected.

primary_sources.heading: The Robinhood Chain RPC Provider Builders Ship On
primary_sources.assessment: Chain-specific archive/debug product lead, not PoPL full-call acceptance or actual service agreement.

primary_sources.heading: debug_traceCall RPC Method
primary_sources.assessment: Chain-specific trace method parameters documented; withLog/canonical-hash/full32M capacity/tier bounds still unverified.

primary_sources.heading: eth_estimateGas - Robinhood Chain API
primary_sources.assessment: Specific estimate method documentation; does not establish required debug trace/full-work gas limits.

primary_sources.heading: Gas Limits
primary_sources.assessment: 550M table names Ethereum/Polygon/Optimism/Arbitrum, not Robinhood; do not transplant its ceiling.

primary_sources.heading: Gas & Fees / How fees are charged
primary_sources.assessment: Execution and posting are bundled in gas estimate; preserve exact complete-fee review and no posting double count.
